text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 105 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea to the southeast of New Guinea and well to the east of Queensland Australia. Justin is expected to strengthen slowly. It is currently stationary but is expected to begin drifting soutwestward in the waters about 600-700 miles east of northern Queensland during the next 24 hours. It is not a threat to land, but does threaten shipping in the Coral Sea.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
